Actor.description: Who did something. There are no users yet, so this is a label, not an identity.
Actor.title: Actor

AgentSettingsView.description: Everything the settings page shows about the agent, in one read.
AgentSettingsView.title: AgentSettingsView

AgentTurn.description:
The agent's answer to one message. Written by the worker as it goes; no revision,
since nobody else edits it (a cancel request is a flag of its own).
AgentTurn.title: AgentTurn

Alert.description: One instance per rule and key. A region that stays below target alerts once.
Alert.title: Alert

AlertRule.description: A condition on the output of a measure pipeline, checked on its own interval.
AlertRule.title: AlertRule

AlertRuleChange.description:
Fields left out stay as they are. The interval, maximum age and alert pipeline may
be empty: null clears them (an interval of null checks whenever the data changes).
AlertRuleChange.title: AlertRuleChange

AlertView.description: An alert with the rule that raised it, so a feed needs no request per rule.
AlertView.title: AlertView

Dashboard.description:
A live view that follows the latest run. Its content lives in its versions; this
record only points at the current one.
Dashboard.title: Dashboard

DashboardContext.description: A message about a dashboard: what the agent makes goes there, into `slot` if named.
DashboardContext.title: DashboardContext

DashboardVersion.description: Immutable. Every edit of a dashboard adds one.
DashboardVersion.title: DashboardVersion

DashboardView.description:
A dashboard with the version it points at, which is what a client shows. The
revision to send back with the next write is `dashboard.revision`.
DashboardView.title: DashboardView

DataSource.description: Registered once per project and referenced by source operators.
DataSource.title: DataSource

FoundBy.description: How an agent came upon a source: the web search and its scope.
FoundBy.title: FoundBy

GeneratedReport.description:
Freeze the dashboard's current widgets at a run. Without `run_id` a run is started
for `time_range`, or else for the dashboard's default range.
GeneratedReport.title: GeneratedReport

GeoRole.description:
Which column holds a region code, in which code system and at which level, e.g.
system "sotkanet" and level "wellbeing_services_county". Level "mixed" says the column
holds regions of several levels, as Sotkanet's answers do (ada.core.services.schema.geo
lists the known systems and levels).
GeoRole.title: GeoRole

Grain.description:
The calendar unit every period of a table spans exactly. A table of windows of
several years, or of periods of mixed length, has no grain.
Grain.title: Grain

api.description: Always ok when the API can answer at all
api.title: Api

page_reading.description: Page reading is configured (CONTEXT_DEV_API_KEY is set)
page_reading.title: Page Reading

status.description: Aggregate: ok only if every part is ok
status.title: Status

watching.description: Page watching is configured (CONTEXT_DEV_API_KEY and ADA_PUBLIC_URL are set)
watching.title: Watching

web_search.description: Web search is configured (EXA_API_KEY is set)
web_search.title: Web Search

worker.description: Task worker and scheduler, judged by their heartbeat
worker.title: Worker

Interval.description:
A period of data: both ends inclusive. A year is 1 January to 31 December; a
multi-year window such as 2022-2024 is one interval, not three.
Interval.title: Interval

LlmProvider.description:
Where models are served. Its API key is stored encrypted beside it and never leaves
the platform: `has_api_key` is all anyone is told.
LlmProvider.title: LlmProvider

MeasureRole.description: A value column and the columns that qualify it.
MeasureRole.title: MeasureRole

ModelInfo.description: A configured model, as the catalog shows it. Its key is never part of it.
ModelInfo.title: ModelInfo

NewReport.description:
A report and its first version, 1.0.0. `content` is a component tree, or
`{"slots": {name: widget_id}}` with `template_id` to fill a report template. Without
`run_id` a run is started for `time_range`; with one, the range is the run's.
NewReport.title: NewReport

NewReportVersion.description:
The next version. Without `bump` the platform picks the level from what changed.
With `expected_revision`, the version is only added if nobody else added one since the
report was read at that revision. Without `run_id` a run is started for
`time_range`, which gives the latest data.
NewReportVersion.title: NewReportVersion

Operator.description:
One step of a pipeline. Immutable: changing anything makes a different operator.
A pipeline is an operator together with everything upstream of it.
Operator.title: Operator

Pipeline.description:
An operator no other operator uses as an input, with what it reads: a pipeline a
person can put a widget on or an agent can build on.
Pipeline.title: Pipeline

PipelineContext.description: A message about a pipeline: the agent builds on this operator.
PipelineContext.title: PipelineContext

Project.description: The top-level container. Everything else belongs to exactly one project.
Project.title: Project

ProjectChange.description: Fields left out stay as they are.
ProjectChange.title: ProjectChange

Provenance.description:
Where a source's data comes from and on what terms. Filled by whoever registers a
source; "unknown" in `licence`, with the reason in `note`, when it cannot be told.
Provenance.title: Provenance

ProviderChange.description:
Fields left out stay as they are. `base_url` and `api_key` may be emptied: null or
"" clears them. A new key never needs the old one.
ProviderChange.title: ProviderChange

Report.description: A name with versions. Owned by the session or the dashboard that produced it.
Report.title: Report

ReportSource.description:
One data source behind a report version's widgets, as the version's run read it.
Generated when the version is made and stored with it: the version is frozen at its
run, so the list cannot go stale, and it keeps the address the data came from even
if the source is edited later.
ReportSource.title: ReportSource

ReportVersion.description: Immutable, and frozen at a run: it always shows the same numbers.
ReportVersion.title: ReportVersion

Rows.description: A small result held in memory: a preview or a widget's data. Never whole snapshots.
Rows.title: Rows

Run.description:
One execution of a pipeline for a set of parameters. It fixes which snapshot each
materializing operator uses, so everything read through the run is one consistent
state. Immutable.
Run.title: Run

Schema.description:
What an operator produces. Every operator states it; `derived` says whether the
platform worked it out from the inputs or its creator declared it.
Schema.title: Schema

Session.description: Exploratory work led by an agent. Belongs to a project, not to a user.
Session.title: Session

SessionChange.description:
Rename, or put a dashboard in the panel, or both. `panel_dashboard_id` set to null
clears the panel; leaving it out keeps it.
SessionChange.title: SessionChange

SessionEntry.description:
One item in a session's record, in order. A session is this record, not a chat
transcript: an external agent's tool calls land here although its conversation
happens elsewhere.
SessionEntry.title: SessionEntry

Slot.description: A place on a dashboard or in a template.
Slot.title: Slot

Snapshot.description:
The stored output of a materializing operator for one set of parameters. Written
once and never changed; a refresh makes a new snapshot.
Snapshot.title: Snapshot

SourceChange.description: Fields left out stay as they are.
SourceChange.title: SourceChange

SourcePart.description: A data source the agent read, so the answer shows where its numbers come from.
SourcePart.title: SourcePart

StoredFile.description: A file uploaded to ADA, to be read by a source at `address`.
StoredFile.title: StoredFile

TimeRange.description: What a run or a dashboard asks for. An open end means no bound on that side.
TimeRange.title: TimeRange

TimeRole.description:
Which columns hold the period a row describes: its first and last day, both
inclusive, as dates.
TimeRole.title: TimeRole

ToolCall.description:
One tool call as the session shows it: the arguments shortened (see
ada.core.services.sessions.shortened), the outcome and how long it took.
ToolCall.title: ToolCall

WebSettings.description: What the web tools may do, from the platform's configuration (read only).
WebSettings.title: WebSettings

Widget.description:
A display of one operator's output. It never holds data: it fetches the output of
its operator from the server, for the run it is shown in.
Widget.title: Widget

WidgetChange.description: Fields left out stay as they are; a spec replaces the old one whole.
WidgetChange.title: WidgetChange

WidgetContext.description: A message about a widget the person points at.
WidgetContext.title: WidgetContext

WidgetData.description: What a widget gets when it asks for its data.
WidgetData.title: WidgetData

post.description:
Check the rule now, in this request, on a new run of its measure. A person who
asks wants the answer; scheduled checks go through the worker.

get.description: The rows that raised the alert, as its last run showed them.

patch.description: Set the range shown until a viewer changes it.

post.description:
The session behind the dashboard's agent panel: the newest one that started from
the dashboard and shows it, else a new one (201).

schema.title: Response List Alert Rules Api Dashboards  Dashboard Id  Alert Rules Get

post.description:
Add a rule to a dashboard. A formula that does not fit the measure's columns is a
422 whose detail names the node at fault: `Formula node '<id>': ...`.

get.description:
The alerts of the dashboard's rules, ordered like the project's feed; for the badges
on a dashboard.

schema.title: Response List Dashboard Alerts Api Dashboards  Dashboard Id  Alerts Get

post.description:
Put a copy of a widget in a slot, adding the slot when there is none of that name.
The copy's `copied_from` names the original. Adds a version.

A report of the dashboard's current widgets at one run; a new version when the
dashboard already has a report of that name.

The cut a viewer looks at: one run for the time range (default: the dashboard's),
which every widget on the dashboard reads.

put.description:
Replace the slots. Adds a version and points the dashboard at it. A widget of the
project that was never on this dashboard is copied onto it, as a pin copies it.

get.description: Every version, oldest first.

schema.title: Response List Versions Api Dashboards  Dashboard Id  Versions Get

get.description: Liveness for container healthchecks: the API answers, whatever its dependencies do.

post.description:
A Context.dev monitor saw its page change: refresh the source. Only the headers and
the signature are used; nothing in the body is trusted or read.

get.description:
The configured models (see the settings routes), whether each can be used (a
provider without the key it needs makes its models unavailable, with the reason), and
the session agent. Keys are never returned.
The operator and everything upstream of it, inputs first.

schema.title: Response Get Lineage Api Operators  Operator Id  Lineage Get
Response List Projects Api Projects Get

patch.description: Rename it or set the session agent's instructions for it.

get.description: Every dashboard of the project with its rules, dashboards oldest first.

schema.title: Response List Project Alert Rules Api Projects  Project Id  Alert Rules Get

get.description: The project's alert feed: firing alerts first, newest first within each state.

schema.title: Response List Alerts Api Projects  Project Id  Alerts Get
Response List Dashboards Api Projects  Project Id  Dashboards Get

get.description:
The project's live stream: each message is `event: <type>` and `data: <Event JSON>`.

FastAPI does the rest of the contract: a `: ping` comment after 15 quiet seconds, so
proxies keep the connection open, headers that stop proxy buffering (X-Accel-Buffering)
and caching, and cancelling this generator when the client disconnects, which ends the
subscription.

post.description:
Upload a file nobody hosts, e.g. a PDF handed out at a meeting, as the raw request
body. Register a source on the returned `address` (a document source for a PDF). The
same content gives the same address; files are kept under the data directory.

get.description:
The project's pipelines: operators no other operator uses as an input, newest
first, with a readable name and the data sources each reads.

schema.title: Response List Pipelines Api Projects  Project Id  Pipelines Get

get.description:
The project's reports, oldest first; with `session_id` or `dashboard_id` only the
ones that session or dashboard produced.

schema.title: Response List Reports Api Projects  Project Id  Reports Get
Response List Sessions Api Projects  Project Id  Sessions Get
Response List Sources Api Projects  Project Id  Sources Get
Response List Templates Api Projects  Project Id  Templates Get

get.description: Every widget of the project, in a session or not, oldest first.

schema.title: Response List Widgets Api Projects  Project Id  Widgets Get

get.description:
The data sources behind the version's widgets, with the address and fetch time of
the snapshot its run used. Generated when the version was made.

schema.title: Response List Report Sources Api Report Versions  Version Id  Sources Get

get.description: Every version, lowest version number first.

schema.title: Response List Report Versions Api Reports  Report Id  Versions Get
Response List Entries Api Sessions  Session Id  Entries Get

post.description:
Add a message. With a session agent configured, its answer is queued as a turn,
which the response carries; `turn` is null without one.

Delegate research to the research agent, as the person: a research session under
this one, with the brief as its first message and its turn queued. Its report is added
to this session's record; it does not start a turn here.

get.description: The agent's turns in a session, oldest first.

schema.title: Response List Turns Api Sessions  Session Id  Turns Get
Response List Session Widgets Api Sessions  Session Id  Widgets Get

get.description:
Providers (with `has_api_key`, never the key), the models with their availability,
the session agent, whether keys can be stored (`secrets_available`), and the revision
for setting the session agent.

put.description:
The session agent's instructions for every project; 409 on a stale revision (the
settings' revision, shared with the session agent).

delete.description: The session agent is cleared when it was this model.
With its models; the session agent is cleared when it was one of them.

put.description: The model of research sessions; null falls back to the session agent's.

get.description: A snapshot a run fixed (`Run.snapshots`): its fetch time, content hash and rows.

patch.description:
Change a source. A changed address or options queues a forced refresh, so the
snapshots come from what the source now says.

post.description:
Queue a refresh and answer at once (202); the worker reports the outcome as a
`source.refreshed` or `source.refresh_failed` event. With `wait`, fetch in the
request, for at most `timeout_seconds`, and answer how it went (200): `fetched`,
`unchanged` or `failed`, with the current snapshot and the error.

schema.title: Response Refresh Source Api Sources  Source Id  Refresh Post

delete.description: Stop watching the source's page; it is refreshed by hand again.

post.description: Have Context.dev watch the source's page and refresh the source when it changes.

get.description:
One turn with its parts so far. A client that connects late reads this, then applies
the agent.turn_part events with a higher index.

post.description:
Ask a turn to stop: a queued one is cancelled at once, a running one stops at its
next step and then reports agent.turn_finished. A finished turn is returned as it is.

get.description:
A built widget, one self-contained HTML file. The frontend loads it in an iframe as
`<name>.html#widget=<id>&run=<run>`; the widget then reads its data from this API.

What the widget shows. Without `run_id` a new run is started, with no bindings and
an open time range.
